The *Paṇṇadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 260) is a canonical verse text located in the Therāpadāna section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. As part of the biographical and autobiographical traditions of the early sangha, the poem commemorates the past meritorious deeds and spiritual attainments of the elder Paṇṇadāyaka. SuttaCentral records translations of the poem into five modern languages [SuttaCentral].
